name: codex
_comment: VERIFIED end-to-end 2026-07-08 against Codex CLI 0.143.0 (macOS, API-key auth) via scripts/verify_harness.py — the woken agent read the briefing file and echoed the canary token. Flags re-checked 2026-08-28 against current vendor docs (0.150.x era); not re-run end-to-end since. --skip-git-repo-check lets it run from any working directory; drop it if you point Codex at a real repo. --sandbox workspace-write --ask-for-approval never pins non-interactive behavior instead of inheriting whatever ~/.codex/config.toml happens to hold on the host — vendor docs say use 'never' for non-interactive runs; a headless spawn has no human to approve an escalation, so an unpinned config fails non-deterministically per machine. Reads are not CWD-scoped in any Codex sandbox mode, so the briefing (written to zugamind/data/briefings/ by default; override ZUGAMIND_BRIEFING_DIR) is readable from anywhere. Optional extras if you script around this: --json for a structured event stream, --output-last-message <path> to capture the final message, -m to pin the model. Set wake_modules/wake_min_salience before running unattended (see examples/harness-configs/README.md) — without a filter this harness wakes for every gated winner. Ships enabled:false by default.
command: You were woken by ZugaMind, a cognition sidecar. Read the file at {briefing_file} and act on what it asks.
